fields.name: quote
fields.label: Quote
fields.default: I'm not a broker. I don't sell financial products or earn commissions. I teach people how to think.

fields.name: paragraph_2
fields.label: Paragraph 2
fields.default: That distinction is the whole point. Nobody in this course gets nudged towards a fund because it pays a commission, because there is no commission. There's a course fee, and that's the entire commercial relationship.

fields.name: paragraph_3
fields.label: Paragraph 3
fields.default: What you get instead is four evenings with someone who invests his own money, has made his own expensive mistakes, and will show you both.

fields.default: People who have already done this course.

fields.name: paragraph
fields.label: Paragraph
fields.default: I just finished Luca's investing course and I can say he managed to break down the complex concepts of investing into simple terms, to the point where **he motivated me to start investing and not look back!** The last lesson, 'the psychology of investing', was especially eye-opening and motivating. I recommend this course wholeheartedly to whoever is not clear about investing, or would like to take the first step but doesn't have a clear plan ahead.

fields.name: paragraph_2
fields.label: Paragraph 2
fields.default: His course helped me understand the world of investments and **helped build my confidence**. I learned a lot, well done.

fields.name: paragraph_3
fields.label: Paragraph 3
fields.default: Very informative course. For many people, setting up an investment account and making those initial deposits is the most intimidating step. Luca breaks everything down so clearly that **he makes the entire setup process simple to execute and implement**. Well done, Luca.

fields.name: paragraph_4
fields.label: Paragraph 4
fields.default: A very practical and hands-on course, suitable for both beginner and intermediate investors. Luca provides a clear step-by-step guide, **from building an emergency fund to investing in the market** and letting compound interest work for you. He is also very responsive and generally replies to messages on the same day. Informative, easy to follow and definitely worth doing!

fields.name: paragraph_5
fields.label: Paragraph 5
fields.default: I recently attended the financial course and found it to be extremely informative and valuable. The content was well structured, easy to follow, and **relevant to both beginners and those with some prior financial knowledge**. I particularly appreciated the real-life examples and interactive discussions, which helped me better understand topics such as investment strategies and risk management. A course that I really recommend.

fields.name: paragraph_6
fields.label: Paragraph 6
fields.default: On his newspaper column, Luca comes across as a nice guy. In person he is lovely. He is patient, **passes on his knowledge using simple, everyday language**. He has a hands-on approach and is highly receptive to questions from his audience. I thoroughly enjoyed his sessions and found them extremely informative.

fields.name: paragraph_7
fields.label: Paragraph 7
fields.default: I recently completed an online investment course with Luca Caruana and I cannot recommend it enough. He has a fantastic ability to simplify complex financial concepts, making them **easy to understand even if you're a complete beginner**. Luca is incredibly approachable, patient, and uses great real-life examples that really help everything click. If you've been intimidated by investing, this is the course for you.

fields.name: text_8
fields.label: Text 8
fields.default: All reviews are from Luca Caruana – The Money Coach on Facebook, where 100% of reviewers recommend him.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.default: No, and this matters. Luca is a Certified Money Coach, not a licensed investment adviser, and Money Coaching Hub is not a regulated investment firm. Everything taught is general financial education. You'll learn how different instruments work, how to assess them and how to build a framework, but nobody will tell you what to buy, and no products are sold at any point.

fields.name: question_2
fields.label: Question 2
fields.default: I know nothing about investing. Will I be lost?

fields.name: text_2
fields.label: Text 2
fields.default: No. Session one starts from the beginning, with no assumed knowledge. Most people who take this course have never bought a single share. The ones with some experience tend to find the psychology session the most useful, because that's the part nobody teaches them.

fields.name: question_3

fields.name: question_4

fields.name: text_3
fields.label: Text 3
fields.default: Every session is recorded and sent out afterwards, and you keep the recordings. You can also send questions in advance and they'll be answered live. That said, the live sessions are where the value is, so come if you can.

fields.name: question_5
fields.label: Question 5
fields.default: Can I ask my own questions?

fields.name: text_4
fields.label: Text 4
fields.default: Yes, that's the point of doing it live. Questions are answered as we go, and you can send questions in advance if you can't make a session.

fields.name: question_6
fields.label: Question 6
fields.default: Is this relevant if I'm not in Malta?

fields.name: text_5
fields.label: Text 5
fields.default: Yes. The course is built around European platforms and European investors, which is deliberate, because most investing content online assumes you're American and can buy things you can't actually access. If you're investing from anywhere in the EU, it applies.
